extensions.problem_statement: Validate invoice submissions against milestone Acceptance records (Exhibit E), flag discrepancies, auto-route for approval, track payment status (Net 90), and generate service credit invoices when required. Rogers PM/ARR or Rogers SCM reviews all invoices before approval. Success measured through invoice validation accuracy, payment processing cycle time, and service credit calculation accuracy.
